name: associated_institutions
description: Institutions related to this one.

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the related institution.

fields.name: ror
fields.description: ROR ID of the related institution.

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the related institution.

fields.name: country_code
fields.description: Country of the related institution (ISO alpha-2). Example: DE, US, GB

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the related institution. Example: healthcare, education

fields.name: relationship
fields.description: How the related institution relates to this one. Possible values: parent | child | related

name: cited_by_count
description: The total number Works that cite a work created by an author affiliated with this institution. Or less formally: the number of citations this institution has collected.

name: country_code
description: The country where this institution is located, represented as an ISO two-letter country code. Example: DE, US, GB

name: counts_by_year
description: works_count and cited_by_count for each of the last ten years, binned by year.

fields.name: year
fields.description: The year the counts refer to. Example: 2024

fields.name: works_count
fields.description: Number of works published in that year.

fields.name: cited_by_count
fields.description: Number of citations received in that year.

fields.name: oa_works_count
fields.description: Number of open access works affiliated with this institution in the given year.

name: created_date
description: The date this Institution object was created in the OpenAlex dataset, expressed as an ISO 8601 date string. Example: 2017-08-08

name: display_name
description: The primary name of the institution. Example: University of Michigan–Ann Arbor

name: display_name_acronyms
description: Acronyms or initialisms that people sometimes use instead of the full display_name. Example: ["UM", "U-M"]

name: display_name_alternatives
description: Other names people may use for this institution. Example: ["University of Michigan"]

name: geo
description: Geographic location of this institution.

fields.name: city
fields.description: City where the institution is located. Example: Ann Arbor

fields.name: geonames_city_id
fields.description: GeoNames ID of the city. Example: 4984247

fields.name: region
fields.description: Region or state, where known. Example: Michigan

fields.name: country_code
fields.description: Country (ISO alpha-2). Example: US

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country name. Example: United States

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Latitude (decimal degrees, stored as string). Example: 42.27756

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Longitude (decimal degrees, stored as string). Example: -83.74088

name: homepage_url
description: The URL for institution's primary homepage. Example: https://umich.edu

name: id
description: The OpenAlex ID for this institution. Example: https://openalex.org/I27837315

name: ids
description: Persistent identifiers OpenAlex holds for this institution, keyed by namespace. IDs are expressed as URIs where possible.

fields.name: openalex
fields.description: The OpenAlex ID, same as id. Example: https://openalex.org/I27837315

fields.name: ror
fields.description: ROR ID, as a URL. Example: https://ror.org/00jmfr291

fields.name: grid
fields.description: GRID ID (legacy; GRID was superseded by ROR). Example: grid.214458.e

fields.name: wikipedia
fields.description: Wikipedia page URL. Example: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/University%20of%20Michigan

fields.name: wikidata
fields.description: Wikidata ID, as a URL. Example: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q230492

fields.name: mag
fields.description: Microsoft Academic Graph ID (legacy).

name: image_thumbnail_url
description: Same as image_url, but it's a smaller image.

name: is_super_system
description: True if this institution is a super system. Possible values: true | false

name: image_url
description: URL of an image representing this institution, usually a logo or seal hosted on Wikimedia.

name: lineage
description: OpenAlex IDs of institutions. The list will include this institution's ID, as well as any parent institutions. If this institution has no parent institutions, this list will only contain its own ID. Example: ["https://openalex.org/I27837315"]

name: repositories
description: Repositories (Sources with type: repository) that have this institution as their host_organization.

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the repository source. Example: https://openalex.org/S4306400393

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the repository. Example: Deep Blue (University of Michigan)

fields.name: host_organization
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the repository's host institution. Example: https://openalex.org/I27837315

fields.name: host_organization_name
fields.description: Name of the repository's host institution.

fields.name: host_organization_lineage
fields.description: OpenAlex IDs of the host institution and its parents.

name: roles
description: List of role objects, which include the role (one of institution, funder, or publisher), the id (OpenAlex ID), and the works_count.

fields.name: role
fields.description: Role this organisation plays in OpenAlex. Possible values: institution | funder | publisher

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the entity record for that role. Example: https://openalex.org/I27837315, https://openalex.org/F4320306076, https://openalex.org/P4310320595

fields.name: works_count
fields.description: Number of works linked to the organisation in that role.

name: ror
description: The ROR ID for this institution. Example: https://ror.org/00jmfr291

name: summary_stats
description: Citation metrics for this institution.

fields.name: 2yr_mean_citedness
fields.description: The 2-year mean citedness for this institution. Also known as impact factor. Example: 3.14

fields.name: h_index
fields.description: The h-index for this institution. Example: 42

fields.name: i10_index
fields.description: The i-10 index for this institution. Example: 120

name: type
description: The institution's primary type, using the ROR type controlled vocabulary. Possible values: education | healthcare | company | archive | nonprofit | government | facility | funder | other

name: updated_date
description: The last time anything in this Institution changed, expressed as an ISO 8601 date string. This date is updated for any change at all, including increases in various counts. Example: 2026-10-12T05:31:44.211000

name: works_api_url
description: OpenAlex API URL listing works affiliated with this institution. Example: https://api.openalex.org/works?filter=institutions.id:I27837315

name: works_count
description: The number of Works created by authors affiliated with this institution. Or less formally: the number of works coming out of this institution. Example: 470000

name: type_id
description: OpenAlex ID of the institution type. Example: https://openalex.org/institution-types/education

name: international
description: Translations of the institution's name, as a JSON object of the form {"display_name": {language code: name}}. Example: {"display_name": {"de": "Universität Michigan", "fr": "Université du Michigan"}}

name: works_count_with_children
description: Number of works affiliated with this institution or any of its child institutions. Example: 510000

name: works_count_with_children_and_predecessors
description: Number of works affiliated with this institution, its child institutions or its predecessor institutions. Example: 512000

name: status
description: Status of the institution record (e.g. active). Example: active

name: topics
description: Topics this institution publishes on most.

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the topic.

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the topic. Example: scientometrics and bibliometrics research

fields.name: count
fields.description: Number of the institution's works tagged with the topic. Example: 5400

fields.name: score
fields.description: Relevance score of the topic for this institution. Example: 1.0

fields.name: subfield
fields.description: The subfield this topic belongs to.

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the subfield. Example: https://openalex.org/subfields/1710

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the subfield. Example: Information Systems

fields.name: field
fields.description: The field this topic belongs to.

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the field. Example: https://openalex.org/fields/17

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the field. Example: Computer Science, Medicine

fields.name: domain
fields.description: The domain this topic belongs to.

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the domain. Example: https://openalex.org/domains/1

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the domain. Possible values: Life Sciences | Social Sciences | Physical Sciences | Health Sciences

name: topic_share
description: Topics weighted by their share of this institution's works.

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the topic.

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the topic. Example: scientometrics and bibliometrics research

fields.name: value
fields.description: Share of the institution's works tagged with the topic. Example: 0.0032

fields.name: subfield
fields.description: The subfield this topic belongs to.

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the subfield. Example: https://openalex.org/subfields/1710

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the subfield. Example: Information Systems

fields.name: field
fields.description: The field this topic belongs to.

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the field. Example: https://openalex.org/fields/17

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the field. Example: Computer Science, Medicine

fields.name: domain
fields.description: The domain this topic belongs to.

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the domain. Example: https://openalex.org/domains/1

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the domain. Possible values: Life Sciences | Social Sciences | Physical Sciences | Health Sciences
